'''Kaantay''' was a city on [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] released a statement to the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] from Kaantay early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
